candidates.name: Open Modelling Interface (OpenMI)
verified_facts: OpenMI enables runtime exchange of data between process-simulation models and between models and modelling tools such as databases, analytical systems and visualization applications.
The standard originated in earth-surface modelling but is applicable to other domains where numerical models exchange data during execution.
semantic_limits: A value exchanged between running models is not automatically an observed terrain elevation and requires independent validation before entering a parcel measurement result.

candidates.name: GeoRSS
verified_facts: GeoRSS is a lightweight standard for extending RSS feeds with interoperable geographic information.
It supports requesting, aggregating, sharing and mapping geographically tagged feed content.
semantic_limits: A geographic tag in a syndicated feed is discovery/context information, not a surveyed parcel boundary, terrain sample or vertical-accuracy observation.
